purpose: The episodes each benchmark's official evaluation draws from. A practice plan whose episode falls in one of these sets is refused; practice draws only from the practice side of each rule. ora/environment/benchmarks/evaluation_sets.py applies the match rules to a RunPlan.

evaluation_set.rule: every episode whose runtime.environment_driver is not the practice driver: it loads official initial state seed % trial_count of its task
evaluation_set.source: LIBERO-Pro data revision c86fc3b8293185a6f373677018ff3e37f8391602, init_states/<suite>/<task>.pruned_init; every base and core suite of ora/environment/benchmarks/libero_pro.py

practice.initial_state: placed by the task's BDDL region samplers from the episode (or round) seed; no official state is loaded; a sample equal to an official state of the task (atol 1e-6) is refused; reset.json and round-resets record initial_state.source practice_sampled with the seed and the sampled-state sha256

evaluation_set.rule: requested seeds from 100000 * (1 + outer_seed) upward; a seed is an evaluation trial when the expert plan succeeds and check_success holds, and every requested seed advances by one; the first 100 accepted seeds of a task are its evaluation trials
evaluation_set.source: RoboTwin cf4872cc90538fd4bca761c8db912d8f65e49f2b script/eval_policy.py (st_seed = 100000 * (1 + seed); now_seed += 1 per candidate; expert_check); ora/environment/benchmarks/robotwin.py evaluation_protocol

practice.note: RoboTwin's own demonstration collection draws seeds from 0 upward

evaluation_set.rule: the target split: target object instances and kitchen layout/style pairs (1, 1) to (10, 10)
evaluation_set.source: robocasa a9e152e2 robocasa/utils/env_utils.py create_env(split='target'); the ORA backend constructs only this split

practice.note: pretrain object instances with layout_ids and style_ids -2 (SceneRegistry pretrain scenes); the ORA backend does not construct it yet

unlisted_environments: no practice side is defined: a practice plan on robolab, robodojo or any other environment is refused
